title: Exposure to tris(2,6-dimethylphenyl) phosphate interferes with sexual differentiation via estrogen receptors 2a and 2b in zebrafish.
authors: Cui, Mengqiao; Wu, Xiling; Yuan, Lei; Zhai, Yue; Liang, Xin; Wang, Zihan; Li, Jinhua; Xu, Lichun; Song, Weiyi
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨阻燃剂TDMPP通过雌激素受体影响斑马鱼性别分化，虽涉及分子对接但核心为毒理学表型与基因表达，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Tris(2,6-dimethylphenyl) phosphate (TDMPP), an emerging organophosphate flame retardant, is frequently detected in multiple environmental media. Although TDMPP has been proven as a compound with estrogenic activity, its feminizing effects on reproductive system remain unclear. This study investigated the adverse effects of TDMPP on gonadal development by exposing zebrafish for 105 days from 15 days post-fertilization. Exposure to TDMPP (0.5 and 5 muM, corresponding to about 200 and 2000 mug/L) induced ovarian formation in aromatase mutant (cyp19a1a-/-) line which normally presents all-male phenotype for deficiency of endogenous estrogen (E2), suggesting its feminizing effect on sexual differentiation. In addition, TDMPP also interfered with other aspects of reproduction by delaying puberty onset, retarding sexual maturation, impairing gametogenesis and subfertility. Molecular docking and reporter gene assay indicated that all three nuclear estrogen receptors (nERs) can be binded to and activated by TDMPP. Using a series of nERs mutant lines, we confirmed the indispensable role of esr2a and esr2b in mediating the feminizing effects of TDMPP. Further analysis revealed that the prominent effects of TDMPP on sexual differentiation correlated to upregulation of female-promoting genes and downregulation of male-promoting genes. Taken together, the present study provided unequivocal genetic evidence for estrogenic effects of TDMPP on reproductive system and its molecular mechanisms of action.
abstract_zh: 三(2,6-二甲基苯基)磷酸酯（TDMPP）作为一种新兴的有机磷阻燃剂，在多种环境介质中频繁检出。尽管TDMPP已被证实具有雌激素活性，但其对生殖系统的雌性化效应仍不明确。本研究通过将斑马鱼从受精后15天暴露105天，探讨了TDMPP对性腺发育的不良影响。暴露于TDMPP（0.5和5 μM，对应约200和2000 μg/L）诱导了芳香化酶突变体（cyp19a1a-/-）品系中卵巢的形成，该品系因内源性雌激素（E2）缺乏通常呈现全雄性表型，表明其对性别分化的雌性化效应。此外，TDMPP还通过延迟青春期启动、延缓性成熟、损害配子发生及导致生育力低下，干扰了生殖的其他方面。分子对接和报告基因实验表明，所有三种核雌激素受体（nERs）均可被TDMPP结合并激活。利用一系列nERs突变品系，我们确认了esr2a和esr2b在介导TDMPP雌性化效应中的不可或缺作用。进一步分析揭示，TDMPP对性别分化的显著效应与雌性促进基因的上调和雄性促进基因的下调相关。综上所述，本研究为TDMPP对生殖系统的雌激素效应及其分子作用机制提供了明确的遗传学证据。
